wave: published; E1 and E3 measured, employment study partial
rationale: E1 and E3 are measured on verified negatives and survived attack. The employment study's H1 is mis-specified, H2's strata were empty by construction, and the Ploid arm is retracted. A card that always exits zero is decoration; this one names what is not established.

code_state.gates: make validate green (10 gates); oracle_selfcheck and env_health pass

verified.E1_false_affirmation: Exa affirms verified-false expertise claims at 0.1680 [0.1268,0.2193] (NEAR, adjacent subfield), 0.1320 [0.0956,0.1796] (FAR, adjacent field) and 0.0840 [0.0556,0.1250] (CONTROL, different domain), n=250 each, while confirming attested expertise at 0.9600 [0.9279,0.9781]. Negatives verified against /works before asking. Survived a post-hoc and a confirmatory test.
verified.E1_distance_gradient: NEAR is 2.00x CONTROL with non-overlapping intervals, so topic distance moves the rate. FAR does not separate from CONTROL: the gradient is visible only at the extremes. See docs/DECISIONS.md D034.
verified.E1_control_floor: The CONTROL arm does not reach zero: 21 of 250 claims about a wholly different OpenAlex domain were affirmed. At least 8.4 of the 16.8 NEAR points are error no reading of the prompt explains, which bounds RED-TEAM A12 rather than leaving it open.
verified.E3_calibration: 686 of 750 answers (91.5%) in the 0.9-1.0 confidence bin at mean 0.987 against accuracy 0.889; ECE 0.1153, Brier 0.1191.
verified.R4_environment: Simulator fitted to 500 real observations; solve rate 0.37, inside the 10-80% band. never_verify (0.0455) beats always_deep_verify (0.0277): 3x the spend bought marginally fewer correct answers.

superseded.W3_exa_employment_n299: 0.5886 [0.5321,0.6429] correct, false-merge <0.0127. Measured under the pre-D028 dated prompt on the unrestricted task set, so it is not comparable to anything measured afterwards. Retained as record.

unmet_claims: One provider. Every surviving number describes Exa; nothing supports a claim about the category.
Part of the 8-17% may be prompt interpretation rather than error - adjacent negatives cannot be removed (RED-TEAM A12).
E1 difficulty axis (D031): PARTIALLY SUPPORTED - NEAR separates from CONTROL, FAR does not. D031's two tiers were too close together to resolve it.

E2: RUN, and it FALSIFIED D029 on an answer engine - a free-text capability constraint does disambiguate (C > A in all three colliding bands, paired intervals excluding zero). D029 survives only in scope: it was a claim about indexes with structured filters.

E4 cross-domain coverage: HALF MEASURED. D038's blocker is resolved - OpenAlex institution lineage makes sub-unit containment a set membership rather than a string judgement. 500 responses collected ($2.50, cached). The SEC arm is scored at 0.1800 [0.1373, 0.2324] n=250; the scholar arm is 249/250 UNSCORED because the OpenAlex budget is exhausted. E4 IS the comparison, so no coverage claim is made from one arm. Re-scoring costs $0 once quota resets.
H1 staleness: mis-specified - non-monotone, so no half-life exists (D033).

H2: RUN and FALSIFIED (D041, corrected by D042). FALSE_MERGE is not increasing in collision degree - it is INVERTED: 0.0375 / 0.0000 / 0.0125 / 0.0000 across unique/low/medium/high, n=80 each. False merges are most likely where names do NOT collide, because on a colliding name the provider mostly cannot name anyone resolvable and the outcome is MISS rather than a wrong identity. Never a budget problem: the W3 random draw left three of four bands empty (D027) and E2's stratified draw resolved it for $0.

Ploid: unmeasured after FIVE budgets (R001, D028, D035, D040). Seven harness defects, then a fifth arm too small to claim: 0 of 12 on both renderings. No accuracy number is claimed. What it would cost to know is published instead: n=49 per arm for a +/-0.10 half-width, $9.80 per arm at the measured $0.20 per search.
Trivial floor: withdrawn as a parser artefact, never validly measured.

R4: a policy IS trained and clears the seed gate (0.0461 vs -0.1000, SD 0.0122 = 0.08x the margin, 6 seeds). It is a 130-parameter linear model on a simulator, not the 8B/4B W6 promised (D036), and it learned selectivity but not calibration - it states confidence 1.0 on every answer at 64% accuracy.

independent_read.summary: high as a methodology exemplar, low as a benchmark of the category
